items.html: To understand this verse, we shall explain the matter. It is said that there are nine Nekudot [dots, as well as punctuation marks]: Kamatz, Patach, Tzere, Segol, Shva, Holam, Shuruk, Hirik, Kubutz. However, they also have upper phases, which are the punctuation of Holam, and middle ones, such as Shuruk, while the rest are at the bottom, and their place is under the letters. All this will be explained later.
